conceptual assets.concept: One-bit authenticated state stored and exported by the module
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL implements a single-bit stored state authenticated_q that is cleared on reset (`if (rstn_i = '0') authenticated_q <= '0'`), cleared when enable_i = '0' and otherwise on a rising clock edge is set to wdata_i(0) when we_i = '1' (`elsif rising_edge(clk_i) then if (enable_i = '0') authenticated_q <= '0'; elsif (we_i = '1') authenticated_q <= wdata_i(0);`). The stored bit is driven out as valid_o (`valid_o <= authenticated_q;`). Corruption or incorrect setting of this stored value or of the inputs that set it would cause valid_o to report an incorrect authentication state, establishing an Integrity objective. Structural mapping follows the RTL update and export points.
